Solara — (9.5) PULSAR

CHAOTIC REUNION

"Chaotic reunion"

Level 31. Chaos crew is stuck — gate won’t open. Spida says he knows the guardian: Catipala’s sister. They call her. She falls for Cygnus immediately. He dances. Gate opens. She follows.

[Verse 1]

Level thirty-one

And there they are

Chaos — one point three billion

Disorder — nine hundred thousand

Their crew — Mayhem, Ruin, Havoc

Standing in front of a gate

That will not open

Chaos seemed pleased to see Solara

He noted her bounty had gone up

He seemed even more pleased about that

[Pre-Chorus]

Then Persy asked Mayhem about their bounties

Ruin and Havoc — five hundred thousand each

Tied

All three of them tied

“Five hundred thousand?” Persy said

“Each,” said Mayhem

Rion looked at Persy

Persy looked at his own hands

[Chorus]

Chaotic reunion

All of us stuck

Chaotic reunion

Gate will not move

Chaos tried everything

Disorder organized three attempts

The gate remained unimpressed

[Verse 2]

Then Spida cleared his throat

“I know this guardian”

“How,” said Solara

“She is Catipala’s sister”

Everyone looked at Catipala

Catipala looked surprised

“I have a sister?”

(she did)

(the guardian)

(same mother, different fold)

[Pre-Chorus 2]

They called her

She arrived in approximately ten seconds

She looked at the assembled crews

She looked at Chaos — nothing

She looked at Disorder — nothing

She looked at Solara — professional interest

Then she saw Cygnus

[Chorus]

Chaotic reunion

This is unexpected

Chaotic reunion

Cygnus, specifically

She did not speak

She stared

Cygnus looked at the group

The group looked at Cygnus

Cygnus understood

[Bridge]

He danced

The way Cygnus dances

Which is the way swans were always meant to move

And nobody moves like that

Nobody has ever moved like that

The gate opened

(immediately)

(all the way)

(without prompting)

[Final Chorus]

Chaotic reunion

Gate is open

Chaotic reunion

Cygnus did it

Both crews through the gate

Cala looked back once

And kept looking

[Outro]

Level thirty-two ahead

Cala — no longer just behind the gate

Cala — walking with the group

At a distance

A very close distance

Specifically behind Cygnus

Chaos: “Is she coming with us?”

Solara: “Apparently”

Cygnus: [dancing slightly, did not address the question]
